# Step 2: Compute time-respecting paths from 303 to 1293 within [37896,57095] with max delta 600
start, end = 37896, 57095
maxdt = 600
src, tgt = 303, 1293
# Build list of events in window
ev = [(u,v,t) for (u,v,t) in events if start<=t<=end]
# For convenience, sort by time (already sorted globally)
# Build adjacency list of events by sender
from collections import defaultdict, deque
by_sender = defaultdict(list)
for (u,v,t) in ev:
    by_sender[u].append((v,t))
# We'll do BFS in temporal domain: states are (node, time)
# Start states: all events where u==src at time t
start_events = [(v,t) for (u,v,t) in ev if u==src]
print('start_events:', start_events)
# We'll maintain visited as (node, time_of_arrival)
paths = []
# BFS queue contains (current_node, current_time, path_edges)
from collections import deque
q = deque()
for (v,t) in start_events:
    q.append((v,t,[(src,v,t)]))
visited = set()
found=False
while q:
    node, time, path = q.popleft()
    # If last recipient is target
    if node==tgt:
        paths.append(path)
        found=True
        # continue to collect other paths
    # consider outgoing events from this node after time and within time+maxdt
    for (v2,t2) in by_sender.get(node,[]):
        if t2>time and t2-time<=maxdt:
            state=(v2,t2)
            # to avoid infinite loops, limit visited states
            if state in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(state)
            q.append((v2,t2,path+[(node,v2,t2)]))
print('found any path?', found)
print('num paths found:', len(paths))
for p in paths:
    print(p)

# Step 4: Search for indirect temporal paths allowing intermediaries not equal to 303 or 1293
# up to length 4 hops, within maxdt between hops
start,end=37896,57095
maxdt=600
src,tgt=303,1293
ev = [(u,v,t) for (u,v,t) in events if start<=t<=end]
# Build list of events by sender
from collections import defaultdict
by_sender=defaultdict(list)
for (u,v,t) in ev:
    by_sender[u].append((v,t))
# Start from events where u==src
start_events=[(v,t) for (u,v,t) in ev if u==src]
paths=[]
# DFS limited depth 5
def dfs(node,time,path,depth):
    if depth>5:
        return
    if node==tgt:
        paths.append(path.copy())
        return
    for (v2,t2) in by_sender.get(node,[]):
        if t2>time and t2-time<=maxdt:
            path.append((node,v2,t2))
            dfs(v2,t2,path,depth+1)
            path.pop()
for (v,t) in start_events:
    dfs(v,t,[(src,v,t)],1)
print('num paths found:',len(paths))
for p in paths:
    print(p)
